text: ここを　かくとう　どうじょうと　しっての　ぶれい　か！

structure.jp: ここを　かくとう　どうじょうと　しっての
structure.en: done knowing this is the Fighting Dojo

patterns.name: 〜ての
patterns.explanation: の after a て-form verb ties it to the next noun: the thing was done after or with that action. しっての　ぶれい = 'rudeness done while knowing'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: どうじょうと　しって
patterns.explanation: と before しる gives what you know something to be. ここを　かくとう　どうじょうと　しって = 'knowing this is the Fighting Dojo'.
